proposal.description: The OVERCURRENT bit is cleared whenever the converter is stopped, copying the fault_arbiter window's reset on leaving S_RUN/S_SS into the record, so an overcurrent that stopped the converter is gone from the record
proposal.reason: After a window_trip or window_trip_SS stops the converter (hiccup or fault state), fault_reg[0] drops to 0 on the next clock. A host read after the shutdown then shows no OVERCURRENT, while fault_time still holds the start of the episode.

proposal.description: Once the converter has stopped, the OTP bit is withdrawn as soon as the board cools, as if a self-clearing over-temperature should clear its own record before the next start
proposal.reason: An OTP captured while running stops the converter. When otp_state later deasserts with the converter still stopped, fault_reg[2] falls to 0, so a host read after the board has cooled does not show the cause that stopped the converter.

proposal.description: A host read leaves the OTP bit in place, treating it as a latched thermal-shutdown flag that only rst_n clears, while every other cause bit is cleared
proposal.reason: After an OTP has been recorded and the board has cooled, a host read clears fault_time and the other bits but fault_reg[2] stays at 1. Every later read still reports over-temperature until reset.
